units.source_text: 所谓小岸，就是小岸壮二六段。

en.t: The so-called Kogishi was Kogishi Soji, a sixth-dan player.

units.source_text: 他是名人的心爱弟子，名人曾说过“一直信赖他一个人”，曾考虑让他继承本因坊的家业。

en.t: He was the Master's beloved disciple; the Master had once said, "I have always trusted him alone," and had considered letting him inherit the Honinbo house.

units.source_text: 不料小岸却于大正十三年一月，虚岁二十七上夭折了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, however, Kogishi died young in January of Taisho 13, at the traditional age of twenty-seven.

units.source_text: 名人晚年动不动就想起小岸六段的事来。

en.t: In his later years, the Master would recall Kogishi sixth-dan at the slightest occasion.
